note: The default index: the landing page and nothing else, which is what most visitors ever chat with. Answerable questions are grounded in the landing page itself - its hero, services grid, case-study cards, demos, process and contact sections. Absent questions include facts the site states only on inner pages (mobile design is on /faq), because a one-page index that answers those is answering from somewhere other than what it read. If the landing page changes, re-check every list before trusting a run.
